description: This file implements a cost calculator for Dashscope Chat models, including tiered pricing and prompt caching logic. It defines classes and functions to compute token-based costs for prompts and completions.

classes.name: TokenBreakdown
classes.description: Data class representing token counts for cost calculation, including text, cached, completion, and reasoning tokens.

methods.name: _extract_token_breakdown
methods.description: Extracts token counts from Usage object, handling cached and reasoning tokens.

methods.name: _calculate_tiered_cost
methods.description: Calculates cost based on tiered pricing structure for a given number of tokens.

methods.name: _calculate_prompt_cost
methods.description: Calculates total prompt cost including cached tokens, supporting tiered and flat pricing.

methods.name: _calculate_completion_cost
methods.description: Calculates total completion cost including reasoning tokens, supporting tiered and flat pricing.

methods.name: cost_per_token
methods.description: Main function to compute prompt and completion costs for a given model and usage, supporting tiered and flat pricing schemes.
